name: TrainPush
_intent: Pushing a heavy boulder from a long lunge: both palms flat on its face 2.45 studs in front of the HumanoidRootPart and never leaving it; each surge sinks, then the rear leg drives and the arms lock out, then a strained tremor.
_reference: heavy push / prowler-sled drive against an immovable rock, 1.2 s loop, surge peak frame 16

keyframes._note: set: lunge, palms flat on the boulder
SINK: hips drop, chest in, elbows bend
HIT drive: rear leg straightens, arms lock out

_contact.what: the hands' flat end faces lie on the plane all loop
